start.title: Before All Things
start.text:
Nothing exists yet.
Only you — and the deep, endless dark.

choices.feedback: You wait. The darkness presses closer — patient, heavy.
Your hand stretches forward. Something stirs beneath the surface.
A sound rises from deep within you — the first sound ever made.

silence.title: The Great Silence
silence.text:
You wait in the stillness.
The emptiness aches — it needs something more.

choices.feedback: The word gathers inside you — heavy with purpose.
Your breath ripples across the deep. Something awakens.

voice.title: The Word
voice.text:
Your voice tears through the nothing.
It carries the weight of forever.

choices.feedback: The command explodes from you. There is no turning back.
The whisper leaves your lips — soft, yet unstoppable.

void.title: The Formless Deep
void.text:
Endless waters stretch beneath you.
You hover above the deep.

choices.feedback: You lower yourself. The water trembles at your presence.

choices.text: Stir the surface with your breath
choices.feedback: Your breath moves across the face of the deep.

light.title: Let There Be Light
light.text:
Light bursts from you — blinding, infinite.
Warmth floods the emptiness for the first time.

choices.feedback: The light races outward — filling every void.

choices.text: Shape the light — give it edges
choices.feedback: You cup the light in your hands. It pulses, alive.
You draw a line between light and dark. Order begins.

light_obey.title: Let There Be Light
light_obey.text:
Your command shakes the void.
Light explodes — infinite, blinding, alive.

choices.feedback: Warmth gathers around you — golden, tender.
The light obeys. It floods the emptiness without end.

light_awe.title: Let There Be Light
light_awe.text:
Light rises gently from your breath.
Soft at first — then blazing, unstoppable.

choices.feedback: You press the light upward — it stretches into sky.

choices.text: Divide the light from the dark
choices.feedback: Shadow and radiance separate at your touch.

warmth.title: First Warmth
warmth.text:
The light settles into warmth.
You feel creation responding to your touch.

choices.feedback: You reach upward. The sky begins to unfold.

choices.text: Spread your hands — expand it all
choices.feedback: Everything stretches — wider, higher, limitless.

day_night.title: Evening and Morning
day_night.text:
You name the light Day and the darkness Night.
The first sunset. The first dawn.

choices.feedback: You move forward. There is more to create.

choices.text: Pause — linger in what you've made
choices.feedback: You stop. The colors are yours — and they are beautiful.

sky.title: The Heavens Above
sky.text:
You stretch out the sky like a curtain.
Waters part — above and below.

choices.text: Command the dry land to appear
choices.feedback: Your voice strikes the deep. The earth begins to rise.
The waters obey — drawing inward, making room.
You pause. The sky stretches further than you imagined.

sky_vast.title: The Vast Sky
sky_vast.text:
Blue stretches endlessly in every direction.
Your creation grows beyond what even you imagined.

choices.feedback: You speak downward. The ground trembles in answer.

choices.text: Gather the seas into their places
choices.feedback: The waters rush to their boundaries — eager, wild.

waters_gather.title: The Gathering of Waters
waters_gather.text:
You push the oceans into their places.
Rivers carve paths at your command.

choices.text: Raise the mountains from the deep
choices.feedback: Stone groans upward. The peaks reach toward you.

choices.text: Shape the earth with your hands
choices.feedback: You kneel. The soil is warm beneath your fingers.

expanse.title: The Dome of Heaven
expanse.text:
The sky arches like a cathedral you built.
Every direction holds a promise.

choices.feedback: You look down. The earth rises to meet your gaze.

choices.text: Press your hands into the earth
choices.feedback: Your palms sink into the clay. It yields to you.

land.title: Dry Ground
land.text:
Mountains rise at your word.
Green erupts — sudden, wild, everywhere.

choices.text: Plant a forest with a thought
choices.feedback: Trees spring up — tall, ancient, reaching for your sky.

choices.text: Craft the first flower by hand
choices.feedback: A single bloom opens in your palm. Perfect.
You ascend. The world unfolds beneath you.

land_emerge.title: The Earth Rises
land_emerge.text:
Solid ground forms under your touch.
You feel the earth breathe for the first time.

choices.feedback: Seeds fall from your hands like rain. Life begins.
You watch it grow — slowly, tenderly, from nothing.

plants.title: The First Garden
plants.text:
Trees stretch toward the sky you made.
Fruit hangs heavy — sweet, untouched.

choices.feedback: Sweetness fills you — your own gift, tasted for the first time.

choices.text: Wait for darkness — then fill it
choices.feedback: You wait. The empty sky calls to you.

flowers.title: Colors Unnamed
flowers.text:
Petals open at your touch.
Colors no eye has ever seen — until now.

choices.feedback: The scent is unlike anything. Because nothing existed before.

choices.text: Turn your gaze upward — the sky is empty
choices.feedback: The dark sky waits — a canvas, unfinished.

mountain.title: The Summit
mountain.text:
From the peak, you see everything you've made.
An empty sky — waiting to be filled.

choices.feedback: You reach up. The first star burns in your hand.

choices.text: Descend — there is more to do
choices.feedback: You climb down. The work is not yet finished.

stars.title: Sun, Moon, and Stars
stars.text:
You hang the sun like a lamp.
A thousand stars fly from your fingertips.

choices.feedback: The ocean stretches before you — vast, silent, waiting.

choices.text: Place every star one by one
choices.feedback: Each star finds its place. You name them all.

choices.text: Set the moon in its place
choices.feedback: Silver rises. The night breathes softly.

stars_delight.title: Sun, Moon, and Stars
stars_delight.text:
Sweetness lingers — your creation is good.
Above you, the sky waits for light.

choices.feedback: Fire leaps from your fingers. The sky blazes.

choices.text: Paint the night sky with silver
choices.feedback: Moonlight pours down — gentle, steady, yours.

stars_vision.title: Sun, Moon, and Stars
stars_vision.text:
From the mountaintop, you fling stars into the dark.
Each one a promise.

choices.feedback: More. More. The darkness shrinks with every throw.

choices.text: Set the moon to guard the night
choices.feedback: The moon rises — faithful, watching over what you made.

countless_stars.title: Uncountable
countless_stars.text:
You place them beyond counting.
Each one a covenant — a whisper of what's to come.

choices.feedback: Below, the waters are still. They need life.

choices.text: Rest a moment beneath your sky
choices.feedback: You lie back. Your stars shine above you.

moonrise.title: The Lesser Light
moonrise.text:
Silver light spills across still waters.
The moon takes its place — faithful, quiet.

choices.feedback: You turn to the deep. It's time to fill it.

choices.text: Wait for the dawn you designed
choices.feedback: You wait. The horizon glows with approaching light.

sea_dawn.title: Dawn Over the Deep
sea_dawn.text:
Dawn breaks — your dawn.
The waters stir, ready to receive life.

choices.feedback: Your voice enters the water. Movement begins.

choices.text: Listen to the silence before it fills
choices.feedback: One last breath of stillness. Then — everything.

sea_creatures.title: The Waters Teem
sea_creatures.text:
You fill the seas — whales, fish, swarms of life.
Birds burst from your hands — filling the sky with song.

choices.text: Turn to the land — it's still empty
choices.feedback: The ground waits. You have more to give.

choices.text: Send a bird soaring across the sky
choices.feedback: Wings spread. The bird trusts the wind you made.

bird_flight.title: First Flight
bird_flight.text:
Wings catch the wind you made.
The bird knows no fear — only sky.

choices.text: Return to the ground — fill it next
choices.feedback: You descend. The earth needs creatures of its own.

choices.text: Feel the wind on your face
choices.feedback: The breeze you made touches your skin. It's good.

land_creatures.title: Every Living Thing
land_creatures.text:
You speak — lions, deer, serpents, insects appear.
The earth breathes with life you gave it.

choices.text: Something is still missing — press on
choices.feedback: A restlessness stirs in you. This isn't finished.
They gather around you — warm, trusting, alive.

land_creatures_wind.title: Every Living Thing
land_creatures_wind.text:
You stand among creatures — wild, warm, alive.
They do not run. They know your voice.

choices.feedback: You sit. They press close — unafraid.
The ache rises. None of them can truly know you.

among_animals.title: Among the Creatures
among_animals.text:
They gather around you — trusting, alive.
But none of them can know you. Not truly.

choices.text: Feel the ache of being alone
choices.feedback: The loneliness deepens. You need someone who understands.
You stand. Your hands know what to do.

before_man.title: The Sixth Day
before_man.text:
You kneel in the dust.
Your hands begin to shape something new — something like you.

choices.feedback: Your fingers press into the dust. A form takes shape.
The words leave your lips. The clay trembles.

before_man_lonely.title: The Sixth Day
before_man_lonely.text:
The ache deepens — you want to be known.
You kneel in the dust and begin.

choices.text: Shape the clay with trembling hands
choices.feedback: Your hands shake. This one will be different.

choices.text: Take your time — this matters most
choices.feedback: You slow down. Every detail matters.

breath_of_life.title: The Breath of Life
breath_of_life.text:
Dust becomes flesh under your hands.
You lean close — and breathe life into him.

choices.feedback: His eyes open. He sees you first.

choices.text: Place him gently in the garden
choices.feedback: You carry him — warm, breathing — into paradise.

breath_of_life_sacred.title: The Breath of Life
breath_of_life_sacred.text:
Your breath enters the clay.
His chest rises. His heart beats — once, twice, forever.

choices.feedback: You lay him gently on the grass. He stirs.

choices.text: Stand back — let him see the world
choices.feedback: You step away. His eyes open to everything you made.

first_garden.title: Eden
first_garden.text:
Paradise stretches before you — your masterpiece.
You look at all you have made.

choices.text: Say it — the words that complete it all
choices.feedback: The words rise in you — final, certain.

choices.text: Sit beside your creation in silence
choices.feedback: You sit. No words needed. It is enough.

first_garden_wonder.title: Eden
first_garden_wonder.text:
He stands in the garden — alive, breathing, yours.
Everything — all of it — was for this moment.

choices.feedback: Your voice fills the garden — warm, full, complete.
You exhale. It is done.

very_good.title: Very Good
very_good.text:
"It is very good."
You smile upon your work.

choices.feedback: Peace settles over everything.

rest.title: The Seventh Day
rest.text:
You rest. All creation breathes.
The story has only just begun.

rest_blessed.title: The Seventh Day
rest_blessed.text:
You rest beside the one you made.
Peace fills every corner of your world.
